app.name: Arizo Manage

lock.title: Vault locked
lock.wiped: All data was erased after repeated failed attempts.
lock.failed: The vault could not be opened. Try again; if it keeps happening, close and reopen the app.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Your finance vault lives only on this device. No server, no tracking.
onboarding.pinWeak: That PIN is too easy to guess (like 123456 or 111111)
onboarding.warnTitle: Your PIN is the key to your data
onboarding.warnBody: Arizo keeps no copy on any server. If you forget your PIN and have no encrypted backup, your data is gone for good.
onboarding.biometricBody: Use your fingerprint or face instead of typing your PIN.
onboarding.biometricUnsupported: This device or browser does not support secure biometric unlock.
onboarding.smsAndroid: On Android, Arizo can read bank SMS and bank app alerts automatically. Turn it on in Tools → SMS Center → Setup.
onboarding.smsIos: On iPhone, a Shortcuts automation hands bank SMS to Arizo. The 30-second guide is in Tools → SMS Center → Setup.
onboarding.demo: Fill with sample data (for trying it out)

sms.title: SMS Center
sms.drift: “{{a}}” balance does not match the bank SMS
sms.pasteHint: Paste one or more bank SMS here, separated by a blank line. One-time codes and promotions are dropped automatically and never stored.
sms.resultInbox: {{n}} messages could not be read and went to the Inbox.
sms.senderHint: Which bank sends from “{{s}}”? Only you confirm this.
sms.teachHint: Tap the numbers: first the amount, then the balance (card and reference are optional). Arizo builds a pattern from the words next to each number.
sms.studioHint: Regex Studio: write a pattern for your bank SMS and give the capture group number of each value. Text is normalized first (ASCII digits, Persian ی and ک).
sms.regexInvalid: Invalid pattern or no amount group

ios.intro: On iPhone, a Shortcuts personal automation hands bank SMS to Arizo. The text is processed on this phone only.
ios.s2d: In Message Contains enter one of برداشت, واریز, مانده, debited or credited, and on iOS 17+ turn on Run Immediately.
ios.s3d: Add the Base64 Encode action with Shortcut Input (the message) as its input.
ios.s4d: Add Open URL, paste this address and append the Base64 output at the end:
ios.privacy: Anything after # in a URL is never sent to any server. Arizo wipes it from the address immediately and brings the message to review after you unlock.

android.unavailable: The Android SMS plugin is not available.
android.restrictedIntro: Android 13+ locks SMS and notification access for apps installed outside a store. Two 15-second steps:
android.r1d: On the App Info screen tap the three-dot menu and choose “Allow restricted settings”.
android.r2: Come back and switch on capture
android.r2d: Return to Arizo and switch on SMS or alert capture. Permissions are requested only then.
android.smsHint: Messages are sealed in the background and read only after you unlock.
android.pushHint: Only the apps you choose (Blu, Wepod, Bankino, Revolut, Wise…).
android.appsHint: Only alerts from switched-on apps are read.
android.historyHint: Optional: reads past bank SMS once. Duplicates are skipped and everything comes to review.
android.privacy: One-time codes are dropped on the phone before anything else. The capture notification is generic and never shows amounts on the lock screen.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.warning: No backdoor: Arizo has no server and no copy of your passphrase. If you lose both the passphrase and the Recovery Key, this backup can never be opened by anyone, including us.
backup.passHint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
backup.recoveryOn: On: new backups also open with the words
backup.recoveryHint: Write these 24 words on paper, in order, and keep them offline. They open every backup you make from now on, even if you forget the passphrase.
backup.recoveryPrintNote: Keep this sheet offline. Anyone holding it can open your Arizo backups.
backup.verifyHint: Type the requested words to confirm your copy.
backup.verifyWrong: That does not match. Check your copy.
backup.recoverySaved: Recovery Key saved. Make a new backup to include it.
backup.created: Backup created and ready to save
backup.createdNotShared: Backup created, but the file was not saved. Create it again to save it.
backup.dryRun: Preview only: nothing has been changed yet.
backup.missingBlobs: {{n}} attachments were unreadable on the source device and are not in this file.
backup.replaceHint: Everything on this device is replaced by the backup. A safety snapshot is taken first, so you can go back.
backup.mergeHint: Records are matched by their ID: new ones are added and the newer copy of each record wins. Duplicate bank SMS are skipped and balances are recalculated.
backup.replaced: Restored. A safety snapshot of the previous data is kept below.
backup.merged: Merged: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{skipped}} kept as they were.
backup.snapshotsHint: One encrypted snapshot a day, plus one before every restore. The last 5 stay on this device only; they do not replace a backup file.
backup.due: Your last backup is out of date. Back up now

err.BACKUP_FORMAT: This is not a valid Arizo backup, or it is damaged.
err.BACKUP_VERSION: This backup format is not supported.
err.BACKUP_AUTH: Wrong passphrase or Recovery Key, or the file was altered.
err.BACKUP_NO_RECOVERY: This backup was made without a Recovery Key. Use its passphrase.
err.BACKUP_TOO_NEW: This backup comes from a newer Arizo version. Update the app first.
